name: ankiconnect
description: Anki for Claude: the mcp-ankiconnect server (review, add, search, edit, flag, reschedule) plus skills for writing cards, judging card quality and redesigning bad cards in bulk.

ankiconnect_url.title: AnkiConnect URL
ankiconnect_url.description: Where the AnkiConnect add-on listens. Change it only if you moved AnkiConnect off the default port.

anki_profile.title: Anki profile (when Anki is closed)
anki_profile.description: Profile whose collection is used directly while Anki is closed. Leave empty to use the last profile Anki opened (or the only one).

anki_collection_path.title: Collection file (when Anki is closed)
anki_collection_path.description: Full path to a collection.anki2 to use directly while Anki is closed. Leave empty to find it from the profile.
